description: This file defines the AppointmentProvider class, a state management class for handling appointment data within a Flutter application. It interacts with an AppointmentService to perform CRUD operations related to appointments and manages loading/error states.

classes.name: AppointmentProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages appointment data and state, providing methods to load, create, and cancel appointments.

methods.name: loadForPatient
methods.description: Loads appointments for a specific patient by their ID.

methods.name: loadForDoctor
methods.description: Loads appointments for a specific doctor by their ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single appointment by its ID.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an appointment by its ID.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading state and notifies listeners.
